message.content: {"merge": false, "reason": "The two skills represent conflicting procedural logics for handling negative or ambiguous grounding results. Skill A ('Triangulate...') mandates a strict sequential verification where failure at any step (including grounding) leads to a negative conclusion ('no'). Skill B ('Escalate...') explicitly instructs NOT to treat empty grounding as a definitive negative and requires escalating to an expert model instead. Merging these would create a logical contradiction in the decision tree: one path says 'stop and say no' while the other says 'continue and ask expert'. They are incompatible control flows for the same scope."}
